caption: The drawing depicts a beaded bag with a slightly trapezoidal shape, wider at the top and narrower at the bottom. The upper segment of the bag has a light blue background decorated with floral motifs, including a prominent red-pink rose in the center, green leaves, a large yellow flower on the left, and blue accent flowers on the right. The area near the top edge is bordered with a thin brown strip and a blue triangular pattern. The lower third of the bag has a maroon-red background adorned with green leaf and circle patterns, separated from the upper section by a white dotted border and a horizontal row of green leaves. The overall composition is centered on a plain, beige or off-white background. The artist’s signature, "Christoffels," is inscribed in red in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Bag
